question.prompt: The perpendicular segment from point \(P\) to line \(l\) has length \(3\) cm. Could the distance from \(P\) to another point \(Q\) on \(l\) be \(2\) cm?

solutions.explanation: Among the segments connecting a point outside a line to points on the line, the perpendicular segment is the shortest, so \(PQ\) cannot be less than \(3\) cm.
solutions.title: Use the shortest perpendicular segment
